name: Rivus DAO
rootCause: Rivus DAO suffered a backdoor exploit in September 2024, when a third-party developer reportedly inserted a hidden function into the migration contract and withdrew migration-reserved funds. All withdrawn funds were reportedly refunded, with no independently confirmed net loss. No primary on-chain evidence, code, or incident disclosure is public. A migration contract developed by a third-party for Rivus DAO reportedly contained a hidden backdoor function, allowing unauthorized withdrawal of funds. Lack of independent review and insufficient controls over externally contributed code enabled the exploit. There is no verified contract address or code sample available.
